item.title: Nevis, MN woman killed in head-on crash near Park Rapids
item.description: PARK RAPIDS, Minn. (KVRR) — A woman from Nevis, Minnesota is dead after a head-on crash Tuesday afternoon. Minnesota State Patrol says 80-year-old Nancy Bamlet was driving east on Highway 34 east of Park Rapids when she crossed the center line and collided head-on with a pickup. item.title: Two federal officers who fired shots placed on administrative leave
